why.skipped: Not proven to report earnings (no SEC 8-K item 2.02 in 100 days), so no AI time was spent
why.pass:fatal_bear: The Bear raised a fatal objection, so the decision had to pass
why.pass:analyst_failed: An analyst failed, so the decision passed without calling the Trader
why.pass:no_plans: No trade plan could be made, so there was nothing to buy
why.pass:stale_before_trader: Too little time was left to approve a ticket, so the Trader was not called
why.pass:debate_mismatch: The debate did not match this stock's analysis, so the decision passed
why.pass:config_error: An agent's settings were invalid, so the decision passed without an AI call
why.pass:api_error: The Trader's AI call failed, so the decision passed
why.pass:cancelled: The Trader's AI call was cancelled, so the decision passed
why.pass:exception: The Trader stopped on an error, so the decision passed
why.pass:invalid_output: The Trader's answer was not valid, so the decision passed
why.no_order:limits: The risk limits config was invalid, so no order was made
why.no_order:plan: The chosen plan could not be used, so no order was made
why.no_order:quote: There was no usable live quote, so no order was made
why.no_order:size: The order could not be sized within the limits, so no order was made
why.no_order:journal: The plan already had an order, or the journal could not be read, so no order was made
why.no_order:risk: The risk check blocked the order
why.no_order:events: The earnings and halt check could not run, so no order was made
why.declined: Declined by you: the answer was not yes (an empty answer or a closed console also counts), so nothing was approved
why.declined:timeout: Not answered in time: no answer before the plan expired, so nothing was approved
why.refused_after_approval: Approved, but the final re-check refused it
why.changed_after_approval: Approved, but the order changed at the re-check, so it was not approved
why.journal_locked: The journal was busy when the answer came, so nothing was approved
why.journal_error: The journal could not be written when the answer came, so nothing was approved
why.alert: run_day raised an alert for this stock and no outcome was recorded (see the detail)
why.timeout_no_outcome: Not answered in time, and the outcome could not be recorded
